recognition_sample_budget_insufficient.description: A running task had less time left (remaining_ms) than the next page recognition needs (required_ms), so it ended before sampling. Only for a run in progress; at admission the same condition is recognition_sample_budget_invalid. A scheduled run that ends with it settles as a condition termination and is rerun. Not a recovery ladder trigger.
recognition_sample_budget_insufficient.common_causes: Slow steps or long waits earlier in the run used up the task time; host load lengthened the run.
recognition_sample_budget_insufficient.handling: Nothing to repair for one occurrence; the rerun follows. Repeated occurrences at stage s0 mean the task timeout is too tight for its declared sampling.

recognition_sample_deadline_exceeded.description: A recognition observation (capture, multi-frame sampling and recognition) did not finish within its window, and every observe-only retry (attempts: the configured base plus the pacing curve's extra retries) ran out too; stage names the observation. A retry never repeats an input. A scheduled run that ends with it settles as a condition termination and is rerun after the condition lifts (contracts/policy-suspension.md). Not a recovery ladder trigger.
recognition_sample_deadline_exceeded.common_causes: A slow or stalled emulator under host load; a page whose consensus needs more frames than its window allows at the current pacing.
recognition_sample_deadline_exceeded.handling: Nothing to repair for one occurrence; the rerun follows. Repeated occurrences at stage s0 mean the package's sampling or timeouts are too tight.

candidate_sample_budget_insufficient.description: A running selection step had less time left (remaining_ms) than its candidate sampling needs (required_ms). Settles like recognition_sample_budget_insufficient: a condition termination with a rerun. Not a recovery ladder trigger.
candidate_sample_budget_insufficient.common_causes: Earlier steps used up the task time; host load lengthened the run.
candidate_sample_budget_insufficient.handling: Nothing to repair for one occurrence; the rerun follows.

candidate_sample_deadline_exceeded.description: A candidate sampling of a selection step did not finish within its window, and every observe-only retry (attempts) ran out too. Same rule as recognition_sample_deadline_exceeded: a new timing context per retry, no repeated input, a condition termination with a rerun. Not a recovery ladder trigger.
candidate_sample_deadline_exceeded.common_causes: A slow or stalled emulator under host load.
candidate_sample_deadline_exceeded.handling: Nothing to repair for one occurrence; the rerun follows.

recognition_sample_budget_invalid.description: Admission refused a task package whose declared sampling needs more time (required_ms) than the smaller of its step and task timeouts (limit_ms); pack_operation_id names the operation when one operation exceeds it. It is a suspend code by default: the Runtime suspends the task package until its content or the Runtime build changes (contracts/policy-suspension.md). Not a recovery ladder trigger.
recognition_sample_budget_invalid.common_causes: A package written for an older kernel whose budget rule was looser; a package whose consensus or candidate sampling declarations outgrew its timeouts.
recognition_sample_budget_invalid.handling: Raise the package's step or task timeout, or reduce its declared sampling, and replace the package; the suspension lifts when its content hash changes.

contained_task_feature_locked.description: A run recognised a page (page_id) that its task's feature_locks declaration names as the sign of a locked feature, and stopped there with no input. The host publishes the instance fact fact_key (a session.feature. key) as false for the configured time. Not a failure streak and not a recovery ladder trigger.
contained_task_feature_locked.common_causes: The account has not unlocked the feature the task needs.
contained_task_feature_locked.handling: Nothing to repair: the task is not scheduled on the instance while the fact says locked. Publish true for the key once the feature is unlocked.

cost_commit_time_insufficient.description: Before the input of the step its cost_commit declaration names (step_id), the run had less task budget or wall-clock time left (remaining_ms) than the declared time to finish plus the margin (required_ms), so it stopped with nothing spent. Settles as a condition termination with a rerun. Not a recovery ladder trigger.
cost_commit_time_insufficient.common_causes: Earlier steps or host load used up the time; the declaration's after_ms is larger than the time left in the task.
cost_commit_time_insufficient.handling: Nothing to repair for one occurrence; the rerun follows. Frequent occurrences mean after_ms or the task timeout needs another look (contracts/cost-commit.md).

cost_commit_declaration_invalid.description: A task package's cost_commit declaration breaks a rule (field points at the member): step_id is not a step of the task, after_ms is 0 or longer than the task timeout, or the package's maintenance use is recognition. check-config reports it.
cost_commit_declaration_invalid.common_causes: A typo in step_id; an after_ms copied from another task; a recognition maintenance package that declares cost_commit.
cost_commit_declaration_invalid.handling: Fix the declaration in the resource repository and replace the package.
